issues.text: New in round 2. The sentence before says products have "the one rule on its values, a price above zero" (schema CHECK and UpdateProductPriceRequest's Range). "No rules of their own" then contradicts it. What is true at stage-2 is that Product's class has no rules (no methods), not that products have none.
issues.quote: Unlike notifications, products have no rules of their own, so the case for a separate catalogue is weaker.
issues.fix: Replace with: "Unlike notifications, products have no rules in their class, so the case for a separate catalogue is weaker." Update claim 15 to match ("no rules in its class").
